quotations.old_english: Ne becýpaþ hig fíf spearwan tó helflinge
quotations.english: are not five sparrows sold for two farthings

source_text: helfling, es; m. A halfpenny :-- Ne becýpaþ hig fíf spearwan tó helflinge are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, Lk. Skt. 12, 6. [O. H. Ger. helbeling obolus.]
